title: Plunger Pump

introduction.definition: A plunger pump uses a smooth plunger that moves through stationary packing into the fluid chamber, displacing liquid on each stroke; spring-loaded check valves direct the flow. Because the seal is stationary, plunger pumps reach much higher pressures than piston pumps. Triplex designs (three plungers 120° apart) smooth the flow.
applications: Alumina: high-pressure slurry feed (with diaphragm or packing flush)
introduction.summary: A reciprocating pump in which a smooth solid plunger moves in and out of a pumping chamber through stationary packing. As the plunger withdraws, the chamber pressure falls, the suction valve opens and liquid enters; as it advances, the suction valve closes, pressure rises and the discharge valve opens. Three plungers driven 120° apart (triplex) smooth the flow. Flow depends only on speed and displacement; pressure is limited by rod load and fluid-end strength, so plunger pumps reach very high pressures (water jetting, hydrostatic test, injection).

piping: Fit a pressure-relief valve (integral or in the discharge line) — a positive-displacement pump will build pressure until something breaks if the discharge is blocked.
commissioning: Never start against a closed discharge valve.
Fill the pump with liquid (or ensure the suction is flooded) before start — avoid dry running unless the design allows it.

lubrication: Crankcase oil; packing lubricator if fitted.

video_tutorials.title: Plunger Pump — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Plunger Pump.
A plunger pump uses a smooth plunger that moves through stationary packing into the fluid chamber, displacing liquid on each stroke; spring-loaded check valves direct the flow.
Because the seal is stationary, plunger pumps reach much higher pressures than piston pumps.
Triplex designs (three plungers 120° apart) smooth the flow.

Typical applications include high-pressure water jetting and descaling; oil & gas injection (glycol, methanol, water); reverse osmosis high-pressure feed (small units); alumina: high-pressure slurry feed (with diaphragm or packing flush).

Stationary packing seals the plunger.

video_tutorials.title: Plunger Pump — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Plunger Pump.
Check packing leakage.
Check crankcase oil.
Inspect valves.
Replace plungers and packing.
Watch for packing leakage: leakage at stuffing box. Common cause: worn packing, scored plunger.
Watch for valve failure: pressure drop, knocking. Common cause: wear, debris.
Watch for cavitation: knocking. Common cause: insufficient npsha incl. acceleration head.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
